caption: This tonkotsu ramen features a golden-brown, glossy broth with floating noodles and green onions. In a white ceramic bowl with blue and yellow floral pattern, dark green nori and pinkish chashu pork are served on a dark wooden table with visible grain.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections near the bowl's edge.
The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with pinkish meat, white fat, and a slightly glistening surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough surface with visible veins.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
White ceramic bowl with blue and yellow floral pattern, smooth glossy surface, slightly raised rim.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved bowl shape.
